7597.title: String user echoes create diagnostic events
7597.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude content classifier recognizes only arrays, so valid string user echoes become unknown events and reach the diagnostic fallback.
7597.proposedFix: Recognize string message content as text and regenerate the pinned transcript projections. Autopilot stopped because generated-file changes are outside its simple-fix rules.
7597.caveats: Reproduced the actual provider/unhandled event path in two clean source checkouts, not the desktop UI or a fresh live Claude session. No fix branch was pushed.
